verdict.rationale: Feature flags can be toggled off instantly to 'roll back' a change (posthog-docs-5) and some automated code changes are opened as draft PRs for human review before merging (posthog-docs-32, posthog-gh-1), which covers rollback and review loosely. However, there is no evidence of an actual version-history or diff/changelog system for automations (flags, CDP pipelines, workflows) that lets a user inspect or restore prior versions. Missing for 10: explicit versioning/change-history UI for automations, audit trail of automation edits, and evidence of restoring a specific prior version rather than just disabling a flag.
